segments.en: The secret of the mitzvah against usury — the Sages said that one who transgresses it will not rise at the time of the Resurrection. For the serpent — its place is in the earth, in the dust — "and dust is the serpent's bread" [Isaiah 65:25]. And there it stands subjugated beneath holiness. And the sin of usury causes the serpent to raise its head from the dust and seize upon the "heels" (akavim) of holiness. And this is neshech (interest) — from the language of biting (neshicha) — the serpent raising its head and biting the heels. And once it has begun to enter, it goes and multiplies and seizes hold ever higher — and this is marbis (increase). And it is a great sin — for just as it brought death into the place of life, so measure for measure: at the time of the Resurrection death will rule over him and he will not live. MS Z
Bechukosai
"And I shall bring upon you a sword that avenges the covenant…" | [Leviticus 26:25]

This speaks of the redemption — as it says: "On that day: Hashem's sword is filled with blood" etc. And this is what it says: "And I shall bring upon you" — meaning: I shall bring for your sake a sword. And this sword shall avenge the covenant. What was the covenant? The covenant was: if Israel are righteous, they dwell upon their Land. But the nations of the world with their enticements caused them to sin. And the Holy One removed them from the Holy Land. And this is what it says afterward: "and I shall bring upon you a sword" — for this sword shall avenge the covenant as stated. And afterward: "and you shall be gathered to your cities." And when you are in your cities and Gog and Magog come to make war — then: "and I shall send pestilence among you" — for "pestilence" (dever) is the letters of "hail" (barad) — which is the hail that the Holy One will send for Israel against Gog and Magog. And this is why "and you shall give them [u-nesatem]" — written without a yud — meaning: you shall give them to the nations of the world — "and you shall give them into the hand of the enemy" — indeed. MS B
"And I shall remember My covenant with Yaakov…" | [Leviticus 26:42]

segments.he: שר״ל ואתם תתנו אותם לאומות העולם ,״ונתתם t oאויב״ ודאי .ני] וזכרתי את בריתי יעקב וגו׳( כו ,מב) .הטעם שמזכיר יעקב בתחלה .לפי שעיקר התיקון שיעקב יהיה הוא השולט והראשיי שבאבות ,שאז הקדושה העליונה לבדה היא השולטת .משא״כ שאם אברהם ויצחק הם הראשיים והשולטים ,הס״א יכולה לינק ,שיצאו מהם עשו וישמעאל ,משא״כ יעקב שמטתו שלמה .ו הל שון של הפסוק שאומר :״ואף את בריתי״ מורה כך, שהיה לולומר :״ובריתי״ בלא אף ,אבל אומר :״וזכרתי את ברי תייעקוב״ זה העיקר .״ו אף״ — הב׳ אחרים יהיו נגררים אחריו. ״והארץ אזכור״ ,זה סוד התחברות מלכות בחג״ת ,תיקון המרכבה שלמה .ולפי שתיקון זו״ן נמשך מאו״א המאירים עליהם ,זה סוד הזכירה הנזכרת כאן ,שהזכירה נמשכת מאו״א כידוע .והטעם שמזכיר זה באמצע הצרות והתוכחות ,לר מוז שבתוקף הצרות מתגלה סדר תיקון הראוי ליתן חיזוק .אלא שאח״כ נסתר ,דאינו אלא לפי שעה. והטעם שאומר יעקוב בוי״ו .יעק״ב הוא סוד קטנות ,ככתוב :״מי יקום יעקב כי קטן הוא״ ,ומשם נמשך הגלות שהוא סוד המיתה ,ב סוד :״במחשכים הושיבני״ .והתיקון הוא להמשיך אליו בחינת החיים ,וזה סוד אות ו׳ שהיא בסוד עץ החיים כידוע .ו עוד :שיעקב בסוד קטנות הוא בסוד י׳ ,וצריך לתקנו בסוד גדלות ,וזו היא הי׳ שמתגדלת ונעשית ו׳. ו עוד אמרו רז״ל :שיעקב נטל ו׳ מאליהו לערבון ואינו מחזירה לועדזמן הגאולה .יעקב ואליהו כבר ידוע שהם במדרגת ת״ת ויסוד .וכבר ידוע .שאין תיקונו שלי סוד נשלם אלא בהארת הת״ת ,ב סוד :״אלה תולדות יעקב יוסף״. וזה סוד ו׳ רברבא שיש בת״ת ,ו׳ זעירא שהיא ביסוד .שסוד הו׳ היא בת״ת, והוא מתקן היסוד בסוד הארות הניתן לו מבחינתו שהם מבחינת ווים ,אלא שכשהם ביסוד נעשים קטנים .וי סוד בו תלוי גאולתן של ישראל ,שנקרא גואל ,וזה הטעם שהגאולה באה על ידי אליהו שהוא ביסוד .נמצא שזה הסוד שיעקב נטל ו׳ מאליהו ואינו מחזירה לועדזמן הגאולה .בז מן שבית המקדש קיים הת״ת היה נותן הארה ליסוד מבחינת עצמו שהוא ר.ובזמן הגלות נאמר :״ונהר יחרב ויב ש״ ,שחסר ממנו השפע ,שהת״ת מונע ממנו השפע — סוד הו׳ הזאת .ו בזמן הגאולה .הת״ת יחזיר הו׳ הזאת ליסוד .ויעקב יתן הו׳ לאליהו .ויהיה תיקון למעלה ולמטה כראוי[ .א]
segments.en: The reason Yaakov is mentioned first: because the essential rectification is that Yaakov shall be the dominant and primary one among the Patriarchs — for then the supernal holiness alone holds sway. Unlike when Avraham and Yitzchak are the primary ones — the Sitra Achra can draw from them, for Eisav and Yishmael emerged from them. Unlike Yaakov, whose "bed is complete" (mishkav shelem). And the language of the verse demonstrates this — for it should have said "and My covenant" without "also" (af). But it says: "And I shall remember My covenant with Yaakov" — this is the primary one. "And also" (ve-af) — the other two will follow in his wake.

"And the Land I shall remember" — this is the secret of the joining of Malchus with Chesed, Gevura, Tiferes — the rectification of the complete Chariot (Merkava). And since the rectification of Zu"n flows from Abba and Ima illuminating upon them — this is the secret of the "remembering" mentioned here. For "remembering" (zechira) flows from Abba and Ima, as is known. And the reason this is mentioned in the middle of the sufferings and the rebukes: to allude that within the intensity of the sufferings the order of the proper rectification is revealed to give strength. But afterward it is concealed again — for it is only temporary.

And the reason it says "Yaakov" spelled with a vav (יעקוב). Yaakov (יעקב) without the vav is the dimension of "smallness" (katnus) — as it is written: "Who will establish Yaakov? For he is small" [Amos 7:2]. And from there the exile flows — which is the dimension of death — in the dimension of: "He made me dwell in darkness" [Lamentations 3:6]. And the rectification is to draw to him the aspect of life — and this is the secret of the letter vav, which is…

Bechukosai — Continuation

"And I shall remember My covenant with Yaakov…" — Full continuation[Leviticus 26:42 — MS A] …and this is the secret of the letter vav, which is in the dimension of the Tree of Life (Etz ha-Chayyim), as is known. Furthermore: Yaakov in the dimension of smallness (katnus) is in the dimension of the yud. And one must rectify him in the dimension of greatness (gadlus) — and this is the yud that grows and becomes a vav. And furthermore the Sages said: Yaakov took the vav from Eliyahu as collateral (eiravon), and will not return it to him until the time of the redemption. Yaakov and Eliyahu are already known to be at the levels of Tiferes and Yesod. And it is already known that the rectification of Yesod is only completed through the illumination of Tiferes — in the dimension of: "These are the generations of Yaakov — Yosef" [Genesis 37:2]. And this is the secret of the large vav (vav rabbah) which is in Tiferes, and the small vav (vav ze'ira) which is in Yesod. For the secret of the vav is in Tiferes, and it rectifies Yesod through the illuminations it gives it from its own dimension — which are the illuminations of the vavim (hooks) — but when they reach Yesod they become small. And upon Yesod depends the redemption of Israel — for it is called "Redeemer" (go'el). And this is the reason the redemption comes through Eliyahu, who is in Yesod. Thus the secret of Yaakov taking the vav from Eliyahu and not returning it to him until the time of the redemption: at the time when the Beis HaMikdash stood, Tiferes gave illumination to Yesod from its own dimension — which is the vav. But in the time of exile it is said: "and the river dries up and is parched" [Isaiah 19:5] — the divine influence is lacking from it, for Tiferes withholds the influence from it — this is the secret of this vav. But at the time of the redemption, Tiferes will return this vav to Yesod. And Yaakov will give the vav to Eliyahu. And the rectification will be complete above and below as it should be. segments.en: This speaks about Pharaoh. The Sages said: one who takes from the dedicated thing (cherem) — first his possessions are taken from him, and afterward he himself. The cherem are Israel — for just as the cherem belongs to the Holy One, so Israel belong to the Holy One. And it says: "all" — meaning even the wicked among them, for even they are full of mitzvos like a pomegranate. And this is what it says: "Every dedicated thing that is devoted from man." One must note precisely why it says "from man" (min ha-adam) — obviously it is from a man. But it is saying: "from man" — meaning from Pharaoh, for he thought himself to be a god. And this is what they said: "Behold, he goes out to the water" — that he would go out to relieve himself in private. And this is what it says: "from man" — this is Pharaoh as stated. "Shall not be redeemed" — it is not enough that he gave the possessions to Israel when they went out of Egypt — as it is written: "and they despoiled Egypt" [Exodus 12:36]. But rather: "he shall surely be put to death" — and these are two deaths: one from the firstborn, and one at the Sea of Reeds. "He shall surely be put to death" — indeed. MS Y

"From twenty years of age and upward… a man for a man for every tribe…" | [Numbers 1:3–4]

segments.he: מבן עשרים שנה וגו׳ (א ,ג־ד) .סוד המנץ הזה של אנשים הראוים למלחמה דווקא ,זאת היתה הכנה למלחמות ארץ ישראל ,שכשם שהיו נמנים, כךנמשך להם לכל אחד ואחד בפרטות כח להכניע האויבים אח״כ בארץ ישראל .ונעשית הכנה ב מדבר — מקום שליטת הס״א ,להכניעה דווקא במקומה ,שזאת היא ההכנעה הראויה .וזה סוד התחלת הספר ״במדבר סיני״, שדווקא במדבר הוצרך הענץ הזה .ולא היו הולכים למלחמה אלא בןכ׳ שנה. והסוד הוא ,כתוב :״ה׳ איש מלחמה״ ,ז״א הוא לוחם עם הס״א ,ואימתי ישלו כחזה ללחום — כשהוא איש ,כ שישלוכ׳ שנים ,דהיינו כש השלימו להאיר עליו כל עניני הגדלות .וג״כ למטה לא היו הולכים למלחמה אלא בןכ׳ שנה, שה שלימו כל האורות להאיר למטה כדוגמא של מעלה. וזה הענין נעשה על ידי משהואהרן — הנשמות היותר גדולו ת שבישראל ,ותיקונים גדולי ם נעשים על ידם .אבל בכאן היו ג״כ י״ב נשיאים. והסוד הוא ,ש מושל הוי״ה ב״ה הוא סוד חרב כידוע ,להרוג הס״א .וכבר כתוב :״ה׳ איש מלחמה״ .ועכ שיו שהיו צריכים לקבל כחמשמושל הוי״ה ב״ה לעשות המלחמות ,קבלו כחמן השם הזה עםי״ב צירופיו ,וז״ס י״ב נשיאים .עוד טעם אחר .הנשיאים היו י״ב .ומשהואהרן עמהם הם י״ד .ז״ס היד שמאלית שלוחמת עם הס״א .כמ״ ש :״ויאמר כי יד״ .שכל אלו היו הכנות במדבר דווקא .להכניע הס״א ,כדי שיו כלו לנקום נקמת אויביהם אח״כ באח וכלה אהרן ובניו לכסות את הקדש ו גו׳( ד ,טו) .קדש הוא באבא .ואבא טמיר וגניז והוא סתום הרבה .ולכך היו אלו כלי קדש מכוסים ,כיון שהם במעלה כלכך גבוהה וסתומה ,שאי אפשר לתחתונים ליהנות ממנה כלכך ואח״כ אומר :״ופקודת אלעזר״ ,אלעזר הוא באבא ,ולכך הוא נפקד על שמן המאור שהוא באבא .ונפקד גםעל הקטורת שהוא באימא ,ואלעזר הוא באבא ,ואו״א שניהם בחיבור אחד והכל ענין אחד ,ולכך היה ראוי להפקר עליו .אח״כ נמנה גםכןעל מנחת התמיד .מנחה הוא בסוד הגבורות ,ועולה ק״ג בסוד הק״ג עלמין כידוע .וכדי שהגבורות יתמתקו בחסדים ,נפקד אלעזר עליהם שהוא בחסד .ונפקד אל עזרעל שמן המשחה ,שגם זה הוא באבא ,והיה ראוי אלעזר העומד באבא להפקד עליו .אח״כ אומר :״פקודת כל המשכן״, משכן הוא מלכות ,ואבא הוא המתקן המלכות ,ב סוד :אבא יסד ברתא ,ולכך אלעזר שהוא באבא נפקד עליו .אח״כ פקודת המשכן ״בקדש ובכליו״ ,הכל לפי מדרגת אלעזר שהוא באבא — נפקד על הקדש וכליו העומדים שם[ .א]
segments.en: The secret of this counting of those fit for war specifically: this was a preparation for the wars of the Land of Israel. For just as they were counted individually — so too was drawn to each and every one individually the specific power to subdue the enemies afterward in the Land of Israel. And the preparation was made in the desert — the place of the Sitra Achra's dominion — to subdue it precisely in its own place. For that is the fitting subduing. And this is the secret of the beginning of the Book: "In the desert of Sinai" — specifically in the desert was this matter needed.

And only those of twenty years went to war. The secret: it is written: "Hashem is a Man of war" [Exodus 15:3]. Ze'ir Anpin wars with the Sitra Achra. And when does He have this power to war — when He is "a man" (ish) — when He has twenty years. That is: when all the matters of greatness (gadlus) have completed their illumination upon Him. And correspondingly below, only those of twenty years went to war — when all the lights have completed their illumination below, in the pattern of above.

And this matter was accomplished through Moshe and Aharon — the greatest souls among Israel, and great rectifications are made through them. But here there were also twelve princes. The secret: the Name הוי״ה, Blessed is He, is the secret of a sword, as is known — to slay the Sitra Achra. And as it is written: "Hashem is a man of war." And now, as they needed to receive power from the Name הוי״ה, Blessed is He, to wage the wars — they received power from this Name with its twelve permutations. And this is the secret of the twelve princes. Furthermore another reason: the princes were twelve, and with Moshe and Aharon among them they are fourteen. This is the secret of the left hand (yad) that wars with the Sitra Achra — as it says: "for a hand [yad]" [Exodus 17:16]. For all these were preparations specifically in the desert — to subdue the Sitra Achra — so that they would be able to take vengeance on their enemies afterward in the Land of Israel. MS A
"And when Aharon and his sons have finished covering the holy…" | [Numbers 4:15]

"Holy" (kodesh) is in Abba. And Abba is hidden and concealed and very sealed. Therefore these holy vessels were covered — since they are at such a lofty and sealed level, it is impossible for those below to benefit from it so openly.

And afterward it says: "and the appointment of Elazar" — Elazar is in Abba, and therefore he is appointed over the oil of the lamp (shemen ha-ma'or), which is in Abba. And he is appointed also over the incense (ketores), which is in Ima. And Elazar is in Abba — and Abba and Ima are both in one union and everything is one matter. Therefore it was fitting that he be appointed over it. Afterward he is counted also over the continual meal offering (minchas ha-tamid). The meal offering is in the secret of the Gevuros, and it ascends to 103 in the secret of the 103 worlds, as is known. And so that the Gevuros be sweetened with Chesedim, Elazar — who is in Chesed — is appointed over them. And he is appointed over the anointing oil (shemen ha-mishcha) — for this too is in Abba, and it was fitting that Elazar who stands in Abba be appointed over it. Afterward it says: "the appointment of the entire Mishkan" — the Mishkan is Malchus. And Abba is the one who rectifies Malchus — in the dimension of: "Abba founded the daughter." Therefore Elazar who is in Abba is appointed over it. Afterward: the appointment of the Mishkan "in the holy place and its vessels" — all according to the level of Elazar who is in Abba — appointed over the holy place and its vessels that stand there. MS A

segments.he: ולקח הכהן מים קדו שים .וגו׳( ה ,יז) .הרשעים הופכים מדת הרחמים למידת הדין כמ״ש רז״ל ,ולכך על ידי המים שהוא החסד נעשה דין עליה, כמ״ש :״וצבתה בטנה״..וזה סוד מי המבול ,שנהפך עליהם מדת החסד לדין. ואמרו חכמים ,שצריך ליתן בתוכם איזה דבר מר .והסוד הוא ,היה צריך ליתן בתוכם איזה דבר הבא מבחינת דין — להחזיר המים שהם חסד לבחינת דין. ולפי שכתוב :״אם חטאת מה תפעל בו״ שמעשיהם של בני אדם לא היה אפשר להם לפעול במאורות העליונים ולהפך המדות לפי מעשיהם ,אם לא היה כחו שלשם הוי״ה ב״ה שהוא פועל במדו ת כפי רצונו ,והוא רוצה להנהיגם כפי מעשי בני אדם .ו לכך(אלו המים לא היו יכולים לפ עול דין כפי טבעם ,אם לא) שמושל הוי״ה ב״ה באלו המים ,להראות שכח שם הקדוש הזה היה פועל במים כפי רצונו .וכל אלו הדברים עצמם מתהפכים עליה לטובה אםלא חטאה ,וכבר אמרו ח״ ל :אם היתה עקרה נפקדת .המים היו פועלים כפי טבעם הכל בחסד ובריוח ,והפתחים שהיו סגורים נפתחים ,ו שמו של הוי״ה ב״ה — להפך היה פועל אםלא חטאה ,והיה מחזיק כל הדברים לטובה .ולכך כתוב :״ולקח הכהן מים קדושים״ ,היו צריכים לקבל קדושה מכלי שרת לפעול הפעולה הזאת ,ולכך קדושים דווקא. והיה צריך להיות כלי חרש ,להכניע החומריות שנתגבר בקלקול הסוטה. ואומר :״ומן העפר״ ,מעשיהם של התחתונים עיקר פעולתם במלכות ,וב עון זנות מתגבר הרבה החומריות במלכות ,וכבר ידוע ,שהפגם שעושה הרשע למעלה יורד עלראשו למטה ומעניש אותו .ו ס״ז :״על ראש רשעים יחיל״. וז״ס :״ומן העפר״ שהוא בחינת החומריות שנתגבר במלכות .וז״ס :״אשר יהיה בקרקע המשכן״ ,שמ שכן הוא מלכות .צריך שירד למטה להעניש הסוטה .וז״ס נתינת העפר בתוך המים .ואם היתה טהורה ,זה היה עולה לתיקון החומריות ולז ככו יותר. והיתה צריכה להביא מנחה ,ואמרו רז״ל :שלא היתה נבדקת עד הקרבת המנחה ,ולכך נקראת מזכרת עון .והסוד הוא ,מנחה הוא תיקון במלכות ,ואם לא היה נעשה זה התיקון בתחלה במלכות ,לא היתה מתגלית הפעולה למטה. והיתה צריכה להיות מנחת שעורים ,ואמרו רז״ ל :כשם שמעשיה מעשה בהמה כך קרבנה .והכל הולך אל מקום אחד — לתיקון החומריות .כמ״ש[ .א]
segments.en: The wicked invert the attribute of Mercy into the attribute of Judgment — as the Sages taught. Therefore through the water — which is Chesed — judgment is executed upon her, as it says: "her belly shall swell". And this is the secret of the waters of the Flood — for the attribute of Chesed was turned upon them into Din. And the Sages said: one must place within them something bitter. The secret: it was necessary to place within them something coming from the dimension of Din — to restore the waters that are Chesed to the dimension of Din.

And since it is written: "if you have sinned, what do you accomplish against Him?" [Job 35:6] — the actions of human beings could not operate upon the supernal luminaries to invert the attributes according to their deeds — unless it were through the power of the Name הוי״ה, Blessed is He, which operates upon the attributes as He wills. And He wills to govern them according to the deeds of human beings. Therefore these waters could not produce Din according to their nature — unless through the Name הוי״ה, Blessed is He, within these waters — to demonstrate that the power of this Holy Name was operating within the waters according to His will. And all these same things themselves turn to her benefit if she had not sinned. And the Sages already said: if she had been barren she would become fertile. The waters would operate according to their nature — all in Chesed and generosity — and the openings that had been closed would be opened. And the Name הוי״ה, Blessed is He, would conversely operate if she had not sinned — and would uphold all things for good.

Therefore it is written: "And the Kohen shall take holy water" — they needed to receive holiness from the sacred vessels in order to produce this effect. Therefore "holy" specifically. And it needed to be in an earthenware vessel (kli cheres) — to subdue the materiality (chomeriyyus) that had been strengthened through the corruption of the Sotah. And it says: "and from the dust" — the deeds of those below operate primarily in Malchus. And through the sin of licentiousness the materiality in Malchus is greatly strengthened. And it is already known that the damage the wicked person causes above descends upon his head below and punishes him. And this is: "upon the heads of the wicked it shall whirl" [Psalms 7:17]. And this is the secret of: "and from the dust" — which is the aspect of materiality that has been strengthened in Malchus. And this is the secret of: "that is on the floor of the Mishkan" — for the Mishkan is Malchus. It must descend below to punish the Sotah. And this is the secret of placing the dust into the water. And if she had been pure — this would have risen as a rectification of the materiality and a further refinement of it.

And she needed to bring a meal offering (mincha) — the Sages said: she would not be tested until the offering of the meal offering. Therefore it is called "a reminder of iniquity." The secret: the meal offering is a rectification in Malchus. If this rectification in Malchus had not first been made, the effect below would not be revealed. And her meal offering needed to be of barley — and the Sages said: just as her deeds are the deeds of an animal, so her offering is an animal's. And all goes to one place — toward the rectification of materiality. As stated. MS A

segments.en: Now that Malchus had been rectified through the erection of the Mishkan, the divine union needed to take place. And this was accomplished through the offerings of the princes — for the secret of the sacrifice is to bring Nukva near to Ze'ir Anpin. And the first was the tribe of Yehuda. The reason: since the intent of the offering was the rectification of Malchus to bring her near to the King, the tribe of Yehuda is the most essential in this matter. And he was fitting to be first — since he is the secret of Malchus itself. And who offered the offering — the prince (nasi). Malchus from her own side is entirely Gevuros — but when she unites with the King she is sweetened in Chesed. Therefore the prince specifically — who stands in Chesed, as is known — to him was given this matter, to illuminate the Chesed. And all the act of the offering was to illuminate the Chesed to sweeten the Gevuros of Malchus.

And "his offering was a silver bowl" (kaaras kesef) — silver specifically, in the dimension of Chesed. "Its weight one hundred and thirty shekels" — in the dimension of the five הוי״ה Names totaling 130 in the dimension of the five Chesedim. "One silver basin" (mizrak echad kesef) — silver specifically, in the dimension of Chesed. "Seventy shekels" — the secret of the shekel has already been said: its secret is literally the sweetening of the Gevuros with Chesedim — shekel equals 430, like the numerical value of five Elokim. Furthermore: shekel is also Chesed — shin-kuf equals 400, in the dimension of the four yudim of Ayin-Beis (72); lamed — 26 as in the numerical value of הוי״ה and the four letters of the Name. Therefore "shekel" specifically. And they are "seventy" — for between the Chesedim and the Gevuros they are five, and seven in the dimension of the encompassing level (kolel). And each Sefira is included in ten. Therefore seventy specifically. "By the sacred shekel" — shekel's secret is in Chachma: shin-kuf in the dimension of the four yudim of Ayin-Beis. Therefore: "sacred." "Both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering" — the secret of the meal offering is Gevuros, as is known. And to sweeten them with Chesedim the oil was needed.

And still another rectification was needed — that Ima illuminate upon Malchus. And in this dimension: "one palm [kaf]" — the kaf is Malchus. But it required gold and incense — all these things are in the dimension of Ima — to draw the illumination of Ima upon Malchus. And this is also the secret of the bull and the ram — all to draw the illuminations of Ima. Par (bull) in the dimension of mem-nun-tzaddik-peh-chaf; ayil (ram) in the dimension of the 41 letters of Eheyeh. And it was also necessary to have a lamb (keves) for the rectification of Yesod — through which the divine union takes place. (And one must also give some portion to the external forces.) And once these rectifications were accomplished, the Sitra Achra was subdued. Therefore: "one male goat as a sin offering." Afterward: "and for the peace offering: two cattle" — the peace offering truly indicates the secret of the divine union — the union of "peace." Therefore "two" — Zu"n uniting together. "Five rams" etc. — all in the dimension of five — these are the five Gevuros being sweetened by the five Chesedim. MS A

"Take the Levites…" | [Numbers 8:6–9]

segments.he: הזיווג בסוד השלום ,ולכך ״שנים״ — זו״ן המזדווגים יחד .״אילם חמשה׳׳ וגו׳ ,הכל בסוד ה׳ ,אלו הם הה׳ גבורו ת הנמתקות בה׳ חסדים[ .א]
segments.en: This was to sweeten the Gevuros with the Chesedim. Therefore: "take the Levites" — who are from the side of Gevuros. "And purify them" — from the side of Chesed. And as stated afterward: "sprinkle upon them water of purification." And this rectification fell to Moshe — since he was precisely from this dimension. Moshe is from the side of Chesedim — as it is said of him: "for I drew him from the waters" [Exodus 2:10]. And this is the secret of his serving the seven days of inauguration — to draw down the illumination of the seven Chesedim below. And when the Levites were given to him, then he rectified the attribute of Gevura and included it within Chesed. And since he was from this dimension, this matter was commanded to him.

And it says: "sprinkle upon them water of purification" — the Sitra Achra's drawing comes from the Gevura when it is not included within Chesed. But when it joins with Chesed, the Sitra Achra is subdued. Therefore they are called "water of purification" — for through sprinkling these waters — which are from the side of Chesed — upon the Levites who are from the side of Gevura — the impurity (chatas) — which is the Sitra Achra — is subdued. And since the hairs are Gevuros and they seal the divine influence, so that they not impede this rectification, the Holy One commanded to remove them. And this is: "and let them pass a razor over all their flesh."

And it says: "and they shall wash their garments" — it is already known that Nukva is bound to the left. When the left arm (zero'a smol) is not rectified, Malchus is also not rectified and the Sitra Achra seizes her. Therefore now that the left arm of Ze'ir Anpin is being rectified through the Levites, Malchus also needs to be rectified. And this is in the dimension of the washing of garments. Malchus is called a garment — for she is the garment for all the Sefiros. And in this aspect of being a garment, the Sitra Achra seizes her strongly — for it has more hold in the garment than the body. And all this is at the time when the left arm is not rectified — then Malchus is also not rectified. But now that the left arm is rectified, Malchus too is rectified. And this is the secret of the washing of the garments — which are the illuminations of Malchus being rectified and purified from the external forces.

And the Holy One commanded them to bring an offering from the dimension of the rectification itself. Therefore: "a bull from the cattle" — the bull from the side of the Gevuros, as is known — for the bull is the secret of mem-nun-tzaddik-peh-chaf. But He commanded that there also be a meal offering mixed with oil — for the oil alludes to the illuminations of Chesed. And this is in the dimension of the rectification that sweetens Gevura with Chesed. And there were two bulls: one for the burnt offering — in the dimension of the ascent of holiness, for all the ascents of holiness are through Gevura that blazes with its fire and ascends upward. And one for the sin offering — to subdue the Sitra Achra. And this too needed to be a bull — since the domination of the Sitra Achra derives from the side of Din. Therefore the primary rectification is to subdue it — on the contrary from its own root, from the place of its drawing — which is the secret of Gevuros. Therefore the bull was needed for the subduing of the Sitra Achra — for the bull is the secret of the Gevuros, as stated. MS A

ו הניף א הרן ו גו׳( ח ,יא־יד) .הגבורות יש להם ב׳ זמנים :אם הם נשפלות למטה ,הקליפות אוחזות בהם ,ואם הם מתרוממות .אז אדרבא ,הקליפות נכנעים על ידם .וז״ס :״והיה כאשר ירים משה ידו וגבר״ וגו׳ .וזה נמשך — אם החסד מאיר בגבורה או לאו .אם החסד מאיר בה .הגבורות נמתקות ועומדות למעלה .ואם אץ החסד מאיר בה .אז הגבורות הם מתקשות בתוקף הדץ ונ שפלו ת למטה ,והחיצונים מתגברים .וזהו סוד תנופת הלוים על ידי אהרן ,להתרוממות הגבורות על ידי אהרן שהוא איש החסד .״והיו ל עבוד את עבודת ה״׳ .עבוד תה׳ היא השכינה ,והלוים שהם סוד הגבורות ,הם הם המתקנים המלכות ושומרים אותה מן החיצונים. ״והלוים יסמכו את ידיהם״ ,הלוים סודם באי׳ ,ולכך להם ניתן לסמוך הידים על הפרים שהם בסוד אי׳ בסוד מנצפ״ך .וג׳ תנופות נאמרו כאן .והסוד הוא ,ג׳ מקומות הםשישלה לגבורה לעלות בהם ,א׳ בזרוע שמאל של ז״א, וז״ם התנופה ראשונה ,דהיינו להרימה שתשב במקומה .ו עוד תנופה ב׳, להרימה במקום יותר גבוה והוא בבינה — שרש הגבורה .עוד תנופה ג׳, להרימה עד גבורה דעתיק — מקום שהגבורה מתבסמת בביסום גמור. שעומדת שם במוח י מין של א״א ,הכל להעלות תיקון הגבורה כראוי[ .א]
segments.en: The Gevuros have two times: if they descend below, the klippos seize them. And if they are elevated — then on the contrary the klippos are subdued through them. And this is the secret of: "and it was when Moshe raised his hand — and Amalek prevailed" etc. And this follows from whether or not Chesed illuminates within Gevura. If Chesed illuminates within it — the Gevuros are sweetened and stand above. And if Chesed does not illuminate within it — then the Gevuros harden in the intensity of Din and descend below, and the external forces gain strength. And this is the secret of the waving of the Levites by Aharon — the elevation of the Gevuros through Aharon who is the man of Chesed. "And they shall be for the service of Hashem." The service of Hashem is the Shechina. And the Levites — who are the secret of the Gevuros — they are the ones who rectify Malchus and guard her from the external forces.

"And the Levites shall lean their hands" — the Levites' secret is in Ima. Therefore they were the ones to lean their hands on the bulls — which are in the dimension of Ima in the secret of mem-nun-tzaddik-peh-chaf. And three wave-offerings are mentioned here. The secret: there are three places in which Gevura must ascend. First — in the left arm of Ze'ir Anpin. And this is the first wave-offering — namely to raise it so that it rests in its proper place. The second wave-offering: to raise it to a higher place, which is in Bina — the root of Gevura. The third wave-offering: to raise it all the way to the Gevura of Atik — the place where Gevura is thoroughly perfumed — where it stands in the right brain of Arich Anpin. All this to raise the rectification of Gevura as it should be. MS A

segments.en: One must know why here the samech is enlarged (samech rabbah). It is said: "Hashem supports all who fall" etc. It is already known that the contention of the spies was this — that they could not make the necessary ascents because of the great power still possessed by the Sitra Achra. And that they could not ascend so quickly — since many rectifications were needed. And to ascend thus would be called provoking the Sitra Achra without strength — and they would be compelled, G-d forbid, to fall into its hands. Except that they did not intend this for the sake of Heaven (lishem Shamayim). And that was their punishment. And Calev silenced them with this — that they do not know that when the Holy One wills it He gives great power to the rectifications, so that they have the strength to ascend. And the Sitra Achra cannot rouse itself with its prosecutions against them. And this is: "and Calev silenced [vayahas]" — for the samech is enlarged — to say: when the Single Master wills it, He gives power in the rectifications of human beings so that they not fall, G-d forbid, into its hands. This is: "He supports all who fall" — they themselves are those who fall into the Sitra Achra if it were not for the power of the Name הוי״ה, Blessed is He, supporting them. And then: "He straightens all who are bent." And this is also the vav-yud-kuf of "vayahas" — the Name through which life hangs.

"The people" — the Sages already said: these are the Erev Rav. And one must note carefully — what is the meaning of "toward Moshe" (el Moshe)? Moshe wished at that time to complete the rectification of the world. And for this he took the Erev Rav — for he thought that in this way the rectification of the nations that would be accomplished in the future would be made — as it is said of them: "For then I shall transform the nations to a pure language, to call all of them in the Name of Hashem" [Zephaniah 3:9]. But it did not succeed because of the corruptions that occurred in the interim. And Calev too wished to establish this same rectification that Moshe wished to make. And this is: "and Calev silenced the people toward Moshe." "And he said: We shall surely go up" — that they should make all the necessary ascents without the Sitra Achra standing against them. "And we shall inherit it" — they shall inherit the Sitra Achra's portion — like the language of "and he dispossessed the Emorite that was there" [Judges 11:23]. "For we shall surely be able" — for we will already have the required strength to fight against it. But this did not help them at all — they stood by their original position. And it is said: "the people wept on that night" — and they said: they established weeping for all generations. Nevertheless it is also said: "I am Hashem — in its time I will hasten it" [Isaiah 60:22] — if they merit: "I will hasten it"; if they do not merit: "in its time" — which is the time when the Holy One will wish to reveal His unity before all life — "for My sake, for My sake, I shall act" [Isaiah 48:11]. segments.en: The reason Moshe wished to send the spies without the command of the Omnipresent — as the Sages said: "Send for yourself — according to your own understanding; I do not command you." There are certain times when human beings need to arouse the rectifications from below so that the Holy One also acts from above — for through the arousal from below the arousal from above is aroused. But there are times when human beings have nothing to do — except to wait for the Holy One to do everything. And then it is said: "for My sake, for My sake, I shall act" — because human beings have no power to act. Moshe's intention in sending the spies was to arouse the rectification from below so that the Holy One would afterward act from above — and to make the proper preparations for the subduing of the Sitra Achra and the entry into the Land. But the Holy One, who knew that the time was not right for this — since their power had been weakened by the Calf — therefore He did not wish to command it. For it was preferable to allow the Holy One to do everything — and not to act through the power of the lower arousal.

And he sent the spies. Yehoshua and Calev were saved and the others were not. The matter is: Yehoshua is in Malchus. And in Malchus many seize hold. But when she is bound to Tiferes, the external forces cannot prevail against her so much. Yehoshua is the secret of Malchus — but he received power from Tiferes. When Moshe prayed for him, he drew power for him from his root which stands in Tiferes of Ze'ir Anpin. Therefore he was saved. And furthermore he drew power for him from a higher level — from Abba and Ima — the place where the Sitra Achra cannot reach. And this is the secret of what the Sages said: Yah shall save you from the counsel of the spies — Yah are Abba and Ima; yoshi'acha (shall save you) is the secret of Tiferes — as is known — for salvation comes from there, and that is Moshe's root. And so too Calev — he is Malchus that ascends to B"N (52). And he is from the tribe of Yehuda which stands in Malchus. And he drew power for himself from Chesed, Gevura, Tiferes of Ze'ir Anpin — when he went to prostrate himself upon the graves of the Patriarchs. And therefore they were saved.

But the others — on the contrary — walked in crooked paths. They did not strive to subdue the Sitra Achra — on the contrary they feared it. They said: "Amalek dwells in the south land" — the klipa by its nature draws from Gevura which is its root. But sometimes it draws also from Chesed. And then it is a great evil, G-d forbid — since it draws from every side. And this is their saying: "Amalek" — the klippos have great power — they receive from every side. They receive from Chesed — and the secret of this: "in the south land" — which is south, which is Chesed. And they draw also from Gevura: "and the Chitites etc. dwell in the mountain" — from the side of Din. The resh — its secret is the square of Elokim; and the heh — five letters. But still it was not so terrible — for all this is below in Zu"n. But they have a higher power still — for they also draw from Bina. For even there she has some hold — for from Bina the Gevuros are aroused. And this is: "dwells by the sea" — the fifty gates of Bina.

What did Calev do to subdue the Sitra Achra? He silenced them all — "and Calev silenced." And this is because the entire nature of the Sitra Achra is in tumult and noise — as it says: "Why do the nations tumult" [Psalms 2:1]. And the opposite of this in holiness: "a still, small voice" [I Kings 19:12]. Therefore he caused holiness to rest through this power of silence — and the Sitra Achra was subdued. Furthermore: "and Calev silenced [vayahas]" — he drew the power of the Name Adonus (Adnus — spelled heh-samech) — and its secret is heh-samech — to subdue the Sitra Achra — through the power of this Holy Name that indicates the sovereignty (adnus) of the Holy One, Blessed is He. segments.he: וירא בלק( .כב ,ב) .אמרו רז״ ל :שנתירא מסיחון ועוג .כבר ידוע כי סיחון ועוג עומדים ביסוד ,דהיינו סיחון בסוד הערלה שביסוד ,עוג היא הקליפה המקבלת לי סוד ז״א שבקדושה .ובלק מקבלת לכתר רחל .א״כ — אמר בלק — הדברים הולכים כסדר .עכ שיו שנכנעו המדרגות העומדות כנגד היסוד ,יבו או להכניע המדרגות העומדות כנגד המלכות ,ולכך נתירא בלק שמקביל למלכות .ובזה נבין למה רצה להתחבר בבלעם ,שמדרגת בלעם היא בדעת ,דהיינו שמקבל מהדעת דז״א .נמצא שבלעם מקבל מהזכר ובלק מהנקבה ,וכוונתם היתה להגביר לזכר ולנקבה דקדושה. עוד טעם אחר ,כי בלעם הוא בדעת ,ושם יש ההארות שלי סוד אבא ,והיו רוצים להמ שיך הארות מאבא דקדושה על ידי בלעם ,לאבא דקליפה ,להחזיק קליפת מואב העומדת באבא דקליפה .וזה הטעם ג״ב שנתחברו במדין ,לפי שעומדים באבא .וזה הטעם ג״כ שהלכו השרים לבלעם ,לפי שהשרים עומדים ג״כ באבא .דכל זה עשה בלק שהיה מלך מואב ,להחזיק הקליפה הזאת .אבל סוף סוף ,בלעם בעצמו הוצרך להודות מפלת זה אבא דקליפה, כמ״ש :״ומ חץ פאתי מואב״[ .א]
segments.en: From the side of Ze'ir Anpin — where the governance of justice operates — they were deserving of death, as it says: "I will smite them with pestilence." But Moshe wished to arouse the power of Arich Anpin to remove the blemish. And this is what he says: "Please forgive etc. according to the greatness of Your kindness" — which is in Arich Anpin — in the dimension of: "and with great mercies I shall gather you" [Isaiah 54:7]. Therefore he says afterward: "and as you have carried this people" — meaning: just as from Egypt until now Arich Anpin was aroused to remove the blemishes, so now: "you have carried" — in the dimension of "bearer of iniquity" (nosei avon) — which is in Arich Anpin. As stated in the Zohar on the verse "and You have borne the iniquity of my sin — Selah" [Psalms 32:5] — it is explained there as referring to Arich Anpin. So now too in this instance, Moshe was praying that Arich Anpin be aroused.

And the Holy One agreed to this. He said to him: "I have forgiven" — which is the secret of the arousal of the supernal forgiveness which is in Arich Anpin — to forgive the iniquities. And: "according to your word" — meaning: because you said "because of the inability of Hashem" [Numbers 14:16] — and this is in accordance with what was stated — for of Ze'ir Anpin it is said: "the Rock that bore you, you neglected" [Deuteronomy 32:18]. And in Arich Anpin this supernal power is revealed. And to this Moshe intended when he said "because of the inability" — meaning: let the nations not say that this power does not exist. Therefore He said: "I have forgiven" — which is the secret of the illumination of Arich Anpin — to show this power that stands there.

And afterward He said: "but as I live" — this oath was needed so that they would have no portion in the Land. As it says: "if they shall see" etc. But it was also needed for the rectification of the supernal luminaries that were blemished through the sin of the spies. Three corruptions were made at that time: the first — they sinned through slander and blemished the supernal mouth of Ze'ir Anpin. And they blemished another blemish —

ובאותו הזמן נאמר :״בלע המות לנצח״ .ני] דץעםוגו׳לאישכבו גו׳( כג ,כד) .ו פיר שו רז״ל :שנתנבא שמשה לא ימות עד שיהרג בלעם ומלכי מדין .כבר אמרנו ,שבלעם היא הקליפה העומדת נגד יסוד אבא דקדושה ,וכן מדין .ולכך התיקון הוא בסוד :״גם אתזה לעומת זה עשה האלהים״ ,שתבא להם המפלה מבחינת המדרגות שבקדושה אשר הם עומדים לנגדם .הם עומדים נגד יסוד אבא שבקדושה .ולכך משה העומד ביסוד אבא ,המשיך כחמשרשו קודם מיתתו ,להכניע הקליפות האלו העומדים שם לנגדו .נא] ויאמדוגו׳ודאהאתהארץ (כז ,י ב־כ) .המלכות היא מקבלת תיקונה מאבא ,בסוד :אבא יסד ברתא .ומשה העומד באבא ,כשהיה הולך לראות אח ישראל שהיא המלכות ,היה ממ שיך אליה כחמן הראיה העליונה העומדת שם באבא .אח״כ :״וראיתה אותה ונאספת״ ,כיון שארם משלים תיקונו הראוי לו, אז מסתלק לשר שו. אח״כ כתיב :״יפקוד ה״׳ ,המנהיג צריך שיהיה אחד שיהיה כולל כל נשמות ישראל בו .הנשמות שלי שראל משתרשים בחג״ת דז״א ששם עיקר ההנהגה — מקום שעומדים האבות שהם כוללים כל נשמותיהם של ישראל. ו כוון משה לעורר אלו המדות ,לברור מנהיג אחד עלי שראל כלול מאלו הג׳ מדרגות ,שהם כללות הכל .וז הו :״יפקוד ה׳״ ,״ה׳״ הוא בחסד ,״אלהי״ הוא בגבורה ,״הרוחות״ הוא בת״ת .וז״ס אמרם ז״ל :אמר משה ,רבש״ע ג לוי וידוע שכל אחד ואחד ישלו שור ש פרטי ,ולכך כל אחד דעתו משונית משל חבירו ,כל אחד לפי שרשו ,אבל המנהיג אינו כך ,שהוא כולל כולם ,ולכך צריך שיסבול דעת כולם .ולכך נאמר בו :״אשר יצא לפניהם״ ,שאם ילך איזה אחד פרטי ,הס״א היתה יכולה עליו ,אבל המנהיג אינם יכולים בו ,כיון שיש לוכחגדול שהוא כולל כולם. אח״כ כתיב :״קח את יהושע וסמכת את ידך״ .יהושע הוא מצד מלכות, והס״א אוחזת בה .ובסמיכה של משה העומד בת״ת ,היה ממ שיך לוכח מ שרשו ,ובזה ניצול .אח״כ :״והעמדת״ וגר ,אמרו רז״ל :שיהושע היה צריך לאלעזר .יהושע הוא במלכות ,וכל תיקונה על ידי אבא ,ולכך היה צריך לאלעזר שהוא עומד באבא[ .א]

אתהכבשאחדוגר(כח ,ד־ו) .סוד הקרבנות כבר ידוע שהוא לתיקון כל העולמות ,והיה מעלה הניצוצות של הקדושה מן הקליפה למדרגתם הראויה להם .וי ש כאן סוד שאמרו רז״ל :אחד — מיוחד שבעדרו .והסוד הוא ,שבכל יום ויום עולים ניצוצות ,אבל בכל יום ,עולים היותר מתוקנות ומוכנות לעלות .ולכך היה צריך לברור למטה ג״כ הכבש היותר טוב .והיה צריך דווקא כבש ,לפי שכב ש הוא בסוד יסוד ,ויסוד הוא עושה הפעולה לברור ולהעלות הניצוצות למקומם. ולפי שהס״א לא תעלה גם היא עם הניצוצות ,לכך צוה הקב״ה שיבי או סלת עם הקרבן ,לר מת שזה התיקון הוא בסוד סלת נקיה ,שלא יתערב עמו זר. תה הסוד שאמרו רז״ ל :שהיה צריך סלת חטין לאפוקי סלת משאר המינין, כדי שהתיקון יעלה כהוגן ,שיעלו הניצוצות למקומם ולא תעלה הס״א עמהם. ולפי שאין עלית הניצוצות אלא בכח הארת ח״ס המתגלית ,לכך היה צריך שמן ,שהוא בסוד ח״ס כידוע. וזהו הטעם שנקראת עולת תמיד ,שעל ידו עולים הניצוצות .וזה הסוד לריח ניחוח ,ע״ד שאמרו בזוהר חדש ,כשהנשמה עולה למעלה מעלה ריח טוב לפני המקום .וזה הסוד ג״כ זה הריח הנזכר כאן ,דהיינו כשהניצוצות הם בתוך הקליפות הם כמו סרוחים ונמאסים ,וכבר כתוב :״כי אם מאוס מאסתנו״ ,וכשעולים משם ,אדרבא מעלים ריח טוב .א״כ הקרבן שסגולתו היה להעלות הניצוצות היה מעלה זה הריח .ו אומר :״לריח ניחוח אשה לה׳״, ובמקום אחר אומר :״ריח ניחחי״ ,ניחחי דייקא ,לפי שהתיקון הריח הוא תיקון פרטי לז״א כידוע ,בסוד ראיה שמיעה ריח דיבור[ .א]
